title: Concrete gravity dams model parameters updating using static measurements
note: Concrete gravity dam FE model-parameter updating from STATIC displacement measurements: reports the achievable agreement between an updated FE model and monitored crest displacement, which is the closest published analogue of an HSTAR back-analysis.

title: The Prediction of Dam Displacement Time Series Using STL, Extra-Trees, and Stacked LSTM Neural Network
note: Dam displacement time series decomposed into hydrostatic, seasonal and time-dependent components; reports RMSE / MAE / R2 achieved against plumb-line records.

title: An Improved Random Forest Model for the Prediction of Dam Displacement
note: Random-forest dam-displacement prediction with reported RMSE, MAE and R2 on real monitoring series.

title: Artificial neural networks for vibration based inverse parametric identifications: A review
note: Vibration-based inverse parametric identification: how modal data constrain structural parameters, and the identification accuracy achieved.

title: Applications of Particle Swarm Optimization in Geotechnical Engineering: A Comprehensive Review
note: Survey of optimisation-based parameter identification and slope-stability search in geotechnical engineering; context for HSTAR's Bparameter / MAT_DE paths.

title: State-of-the-Art Report on Control of Cracking in Early Age Concrete
note: JCI state-of-the-art report on early-age concrete cracking: hydration heat, adiabatic temperature rise, pipe cooling and thermal-stress criteria - the physics HSTAR's HEAT material and pipe-cooling superposition implement.

title: 3D zero-thickness coupled interface finite element: Formulation and application
note: 3D zero-thickness coupled interface finite element: the formulation family HSTAR's Goodman / MCJOINT interface elements belong to, including the hydro-mechanical coupling.

title: On the numerical integration of interface elements
note: Numerical integration of interface elements and the conditioning consequences of the normal/shear stiffness choice - the basis of triplet dt_018.

title: The steel–concrete interface
note: RILEM report on the steel-concrete interface: bond-slip mechanics behind HSTAR's five ikindks bond laws.

title: Displacement prediction of step-like landslide by applying a novel kernel extreme learning machine method
note: Step-like landslide displacement prediction; reports the metric conventions used for geotechnical displacement monitoring series.

title: Landslide displacement forecasting using deep learning and monitoring data across selected sites
note: Landslide displacement forecasting from monitoring data; RMSE/MAE reporting practice.

title: Machine learning and structural health monitoring overview with emerging technology and high-dimensional data source highlights
note: Structural health monitoring overview: what is actually measured on civil structures and at what precision, which bounds any comparison against HSTAR output.

title: Recent Advancements in Non-Destructive Testing Techniques for Structural Health Monitoring
note: Non-destructive testing techniques for structural health monitoring of concrete - the measurement side of the stress and temperature comparisons.

title: Machine learning in concrete science: applications, challenges, and best practices
note: Machine learning in concrete science: ranges of concrete elastic and strength properties used for the regional defaults in docs/s3_materials_and_constitutive.md.

title: Driven by Data or Derived Through Physics? A Review of Hybrid Physics Guided Machine Learning Techniques With Cyber-Physical System (CPS) Focus
note: Hybrid physics-guided and data-driven modelling: framing for combining an HSTAR forward model with a statistical dam-monitoring model.

title: Resilience assessment framework for critical infrastructure in a multi-hazard environment: Case study on transport assets
note: Resilience assessment of critical infrastructure under multi-hazard conditions; context for how a computed factor of safety is used in dam safety decisions.
